FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURTOF JAMMU & KASHMIR AND LADAKH
(Office of Registrar (Recruitment) at Srinagar)
***
Advertisement Notice No. 03 of 2022/RG/NG
Dated: 30-08-2022
Subject: - Advertisement for the posts in different categories (Non-Gazetted), in the High
Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
a) Date of commencement for submission of online applications: 06-09-2022
b) Last date for submission of online applications: 20-09-2022
c) Last date for submission of fee: 20-09-2022
Total number of posts advertised = ( 30)
Online applications are invited from eligible candidates for participating in the
selection process for various posts shown against Item code No. mentioned in
Annexure-A" to this notification who:
i) are domiciles of UT of Jammu and Kashmir in terms of .O 166 dated 18.05.2020
issued by GAD, Government of Jammu and Kashmir and are residents of UT of Ladakh
for a period of not less than 15 years before the date of applying and are actually
residing in the area.
ii) are having age as on 01.01.2022:-
I) Not below 18 years, and
ii) Not above;
(a)40 years in case of Open Merit.
(b)43 years in case of SC/ST/RBA/ALC/OSC
(c) 42 years in case of Physically Challenged candidates.
(d)48 years in case of Ex. Servicemen.
(e)40 years in case of candidates in Government Service/Contractual
employees;
iii) are in possession of the prescribed minimum academic! professional! technical
qualifications and fulfil all other eligibility conditions wherever required as
shown against each post/item in the Annexure "A" by or before the last date of
submission of application forms i.e,. 20-09-2022.
iv) have deposited fees of Rs. 360/- (Rupees Three hundred and sixty only).
v) applications alongwith the prescribed fee shall be received only through online
mode on the Recruitment Portal of the High Court of J&K, link of which shall be
active on 06-09-2022 on the website of the High Court: http//jkhighcourt.nic.in.
vi) before applying online, candidates are advised to carefully go through the
guidelines for online submission of applications. These guidelines will be
available on the online portal of the High Court of iarimu and Kashmir.
Note:
a) Candidates who are eligible to apply for more than one post are required to apply
separately for each post.
b) The number of vacancies may increase or decrease, depending on their availability
at the time of selection.
c) The reservation for various categories has been determined as per the provisions of
5.0 127 dated 20.04.2020.
d) Submission of Application Form and fee payment shall not be accepted/entertained
after the cut-off date fixed for receipt of the same.
e) Candidates shall not submit the printout of he Application Form /fee payment
receipt to the office of Registrar Recruitment, High Court of J&K and Ladakh at this
stage.
f) Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. In no
other mode, the Application Form would be accepted and even online incomplete
Application Form would not be accepted.
(S. Satinder Sit1'gh)
Registrar (Recruitment)
Registrar (Recruitri'ie'nt)
g) The printout of the application form alongwith the fee payment receipt dii(i
required copies of documents shnll be kept ready to be submitted as and when
req u red
h) The in-service candidates / contractual employees shall submit photocopy of the
filled up online application form through proper channel viz, the concerned Head of
Department. In the event of failure of the candidate to route the application
through proper channel, his /her eligibility shall be assessed as if he/she is not an in
service candidate. The Head of Department concerned shall forward the application
form of the in-service candidates at the address of the Registrar Recruitment, High
Court of J&K and Ladakh within 15 days after the last date of filing theii
Application Form.
i) The last date for submission of online application forms as prescribed above shall be
the cut-off date for determining the eligibility to apply for the post. the age hoot,
however, is determinable with reference to the 1° of January, 2022. An
qualification/experience acquired after last date of receipt/submission of onlne
application form i.e., 20-09-2022 shall not he taken into account for any purpo'w.
j) The prescribed qualifications reflect the bare minimum requirement of the job and
mere possession thereof shall not entitle a candidate to be called for woti en
test/interview.
k) The Criteria formulated for selection to the posts advertised will be uploaded on the
official Website of the High Court http//jkhighcourt.nic.in .
I) Call letters shall not be issued individually, however, wide publicity shall be given
through print and electronic media, official Website http//jkhighcourt nic.in o tli
High Court about the venues, dates of the written test/interview for the
information of eligible candidates. No claim of being unaware of the dates/schedule
for written test/interview shall be entertained.
m) No TA/DA will be paid for participation in the written test/iierview.
By order.
